answer: Attention-decay registration. An identity must hold a persistent query stream (a ridge of recent context) that peers can probe at random; answering draws on stored state, not cached replies. A beacon challenge fires unpredictably, and each correct response consumes a timed signal window that cannot be replayed or parallelized across identities. Enforcement: a wallet accrues registration weight only by sustaining accurate answers over many probes; fresh sybils must pay the same serial attention cost per identity, so N identities cost N times the compute and uptime.
